Class DinosaurFactory

java.lang.Object
gamemode.forest.entity.DinosaurFactory
public class DinosaurFactory extends Object
Factory class for creating pre-configured Dinosaur instances.

Provides static factory methods for each dinosaur category (HerbivoreDinosaur, CarnivoreDinosaur, MegaDinosaur), with each named type having fixed stats, rarity, and sprite paths. Callers only need to supply the spawn coordinates.

  • Method Details

    • createHerbivore

      public static Dinosaur createHerbivore(String type, double x, double y)
      Creates a herbivore dinosaur of the given type at the specified position.

      Supported types and their stats:

      • LongNeck – 150 HP, 10 strength, 40 EXP, level 1, Dinosaur.Rarity.COMMON, sell price 50
      • Triceratops – 250 HP, 20 strength, 80 EXP, level 3, Dinosaur.Rarity.UNCOMMON, sell price 45
      Parameters:
      type - the dinosaur type identifier (e.g. "LongNeck", "Triceratops")
      x - the initial X position in the game world
      y - the initial Y position in the game world
      Returns:
      a configured HerbivoreDinosaur, or null if the type is unrecognised

    • createCarnivore

      public static Dinosaur createCarnivore(String type, double x, double y)
      Creates a carnivore dinosaur of the given type at the specified position.

      Supported types and their stats:

      • Raptor – 150 HP, 135 strength, 100 EXP, level 2, Dinosaur.Rarity.COMMON, speed 3.5, sell price 100
      • TRex – 400 HP, 80 strength, 300 EXP, level 5, Dinosaur.Rarity.RARE, speed 2.2, sell price 150
      Parameters:
      type - the dinosaur type identifier (e.g. "Raptor", "TRex")
      x - the initial X position in the game world
      y - the initial Y position in the game world
      Returns:
      a configured CarnivoreDinosaur, or null if the type is unrecognised

    • createMega

      public static Dinosaur createMega(double x, double y)
      Creates the unique MegaDinosaur preset at the specified position.

      The Ancient Colossus has 1500 HP, 150 strength, 1000 EXP drop, requires level 10, is Dinosaur.Rarity.RARE, and has a sell price of 300.

      Parameters:
      x - the initial X position in the game world
      y - the initial Y position in the game world
      Returns:
      a configured MegaDinosaur
